description: This file defines the Favorites class in a SuiteCRM module, implementing functionalities for managing favorite records, such as retrieving, deleting, and saving favorites, and managing associated data. It includes methods for database interactions and retrieving favorite data specific to the current user and module.

classes.name: Favorites
classes.description: Represents the Favorites module handling CRUD operations and retrieval of favorite records for users within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: deleteFavorite
methods.description: Deletes a favorite record by marking it as deleted in the database.

methods.name: getFavoriteID
methods.description: Retrieves the favorite record ID for a specific module and record ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: getCurrentUserSidebarFavorites
methods.description: Fetches the list of favorite items for the current user, optionally filtering by a specific item ID.

methods.name: getCurrentUserFavoritesForModule
methods.description: Returns the list of favorite records for the current user filtered by a specific module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the favorite object, assigning it to the current user if not already assigned.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the bean implements specific interfaces, here always returns false.
